family.$description: envUI's typeface, Geist, which the package ships, falling back to the system's sans-serif.

caption.$description: Captions, a menu's group labels and other small secondary text.

body-sm.$description: Supporting text: Text's body-sm and caption variants, 14 px in the comfortable scale.

label.$description: The label of a control, and the text of menu, tree and option rows.

label-sm.$description: A label inside a field at the control height, such as a combobox chip's.

body.$description: Running text: Text's body variant and a type role's default, 15 px in the comfortable scale.

title.$description: A section's heading: Text's title variant, 18 px in the comfortable scale: a step above body text in size as well as weight.

headline.$description: A page's heading: Text's headline variant, 22 px in the comfortable scale: a clear step above a section's title.

weight.$description: The font weights: regular for body text, medium for headings, labels that lead and emphasis in a row, semibold for the strongest emphasis in a small space, such as today in a calendar. The same in every scale.

regular.$description: Regular, 400: running text and most labels.

medium.$description: Medium, 500: headings, labels that lead and emphasis in a row.

semibold.$description: Semibold, 600: the strongest emphasis in a small space, such as today in a calendar.

body.$description: The weight of running text, which the body type roles take: regular.
The line height of a theme boundary's text, which an application may set: 1.4 times the font size.

type.$description: Font shorthands for the type roles, as the `font` property takes them: weight, size, line height and family. The line height is in em, so it follows the role's own size.

headline.$description: A page's heading: Text's headline variant, medium, its lines tighter than body text's and its letters a touch closer, as larger type wants.

title.$description: A section's heading: Text's title variant, medium, its lines a little tighter than body text's and its letters a touch closer.

body.$description: Running text: Text's body variant, regular.

body-sm.$description: Supporting text: Text's body-sm and caption variants, regular.
